title.zh: Antigravity 一周年：多智能体新界面、配额重置与 Carbon 提速
title.en: Antigravity first anniversary: new multi-agent UI, quota reset, Carbon speed claim

summary.zh: 官方拆解为并行编排多个 agent 重建的新界面。负责人随后宣布庆祝满一岁，重置所有人、所有模型的配额，并称 Carbon 的 TTFT 已加快 1.5 倍（官方口径，本页未做独立测量）。公开记录里产品于 2025-11-18 推出，与「满一岁」相符。配额重置对现有用户最直接。
summary.en: The official account broke down a new interface rebuilt for orchestrating several agents in parallel. The lead then announced a first-anniversary quota reset for everyone, on every model, and said Carbon's time to first token is 1.5 times faster. That speed figure is an official claim; this page did not measure it. Public records show the product launched on 2025-11-18, which matches the anniversary. The quota reset is the most direct change for current users.

brief.zh: 新的多智能体界面、全员配额重置，以及 Carbon 首 token 加快 1.5 倍的官方说法。
brief.en: A new multi-agent interface, a quota reset for everyone, and an official claim that Carbon answers 1.5 times faster.

why.zh: UI、配额、速度叠在同一天；满一岁与公开推出日相符，不是口头编造。
why.en: UI, quota, and speed landed on the same day. The anniversary matches the public launch date.

notes.zh: 公开推出日为 2025-11-18，但本条发生日仍留空：树上位置仍按报道日，不把周年日反填成另一个发布时间戳。
notes.en: The public launch date is 2025-11-18, but happened_at stays empty. The leaf stays on the reporting day. The anniversary is not backfilled as a second timestamp.

label.zh: 官方拆解多智能体新界面
label.en: Official breakdown of the new multi-agent UI
